_how_to_use: Mavan acquisition search rubric. Covers both groups in ICP.md.
Every list of titles is matched as a lowercase SUBSTRING of the title column.
First rule that matches wins: account_disqualifiers -> wrong_person_titles -> owner_titles
Run `python3 skills/qualify-leads/grade_fit.py --explain --rubric rubrics/mavan.json --file research/<your file>.csv` to read it back.
name: mavan-acquisition-search
campaign: Confidential acquisition search: reach owner operators of US consumer and subscription companies (Group A) and sell side bankers and brokers in the lower middle market (Group B).

grades.A: Group A: founder, owner, CEO or president of an independent US consumer or subscription company. Group B: managing director, partner or principal who runs sell side mandates at a lower middle market boutique.
grades.B: Right company, a decision maker who can route to the owner or the deal lead within one step.
grades.C: Right company, right function, but junior, or someone better is the entry point.
grades.D: Right company, wrong person: finance, marketing, operations, compliance or a portfolio company seat.
grades.E: Wrong company: sponsor owned, buy side only, a fund, a lender, a platform, or outside the United States.
